name: Heaven's Censorship Bureau
source:
A somehow realistic game in which you play as an angel officer of Heaven’s Censorship Bureau, judging the mortal movies and sentencing every "inappropriate" things to death.

Made for Mini Jam 119: Heaven² - Everything Can Die.

[From [url=https://xlores-liang.itch.io/heavens-censorship-bureau]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款莫名写实的游戏：你将扮演天堂审查局的一名天使官员，审看凡间的电影，并判处一切“不当”内容死刑。

为Mini Jam 119（主题：“天堂²——万物皆可死”）制作。

[引自[url=https://xlores-liang.itch.io/heavens-censorship-bureau]Itch.io[/url]]
